notes.title: The game has surpassed 100,000 wishlists!
notes.notes: [p]The game has surpassed 100,000 wishlists and is still growing rapidly! Thank you all for your strong support! [/p][p]Currently, the game is still in a small-scale closed beta test. Once it becomes stable, the test scope will be gradually expanded. [/p][p]Meanwhile, everyone is also looking forward to the Steam New Releases Festival in October![/p]

notes.title: The test is over, thank you for participating!
notes.notes: This test received a lot of feedback, it takes a while to digest, thank you for participating in the test! Stay tuned for the next update!
